title: Virtua Frontier
description: Explore wide-open plains and treacherous dungeons in a performance-tuned adventure pack. Virtua Frontier blends overhauled worldgen, new structures, lightweight RPG progression, QoL tools, voice chat, and shader support as well as great for SMP or solo.
body:
This is a Modrinth alternative for Virtua Frontier on CurseForge. They are not compatible, as mods differ.

Discover more, lag less. Virtua Frontier reworks the world with new biomes and structures, adds fair dungeon loot and gentle progression, and packs in server-friendly QoL.

Expanded biomes/structures & better dungeons
Light progression (artifacts)
QoL staples: Waystones, JourneyMap, JEI, Voice Chat
Optimized client & server: Sodium/FerriteCore/ServerCore/C2ME
Shader-ready via Iris (optional)
 

Please note this pack will be updated to newer versions of Minecraft and may or may not match up in terms of mods used. In that regard, it will always be suggested that you create a new world when swapping to a version of this pack that is a different Minecraft version that differs from what you are playing on.
